findings.summary: The previous-attempt finding (body-less POST/PUT/PATCH answered 415 json_required) is already repaired in the current tree: request() sets Content-Type application/json for every POST/PUT/PATCH and sends `{}` when there is no body (JSON_WRITE_METHODS). No edit by this unit; requireJsonWrites on the server was not touched.

Capability check `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/firstRun.spec.ts` (fresh-db project) was not run: the spec is outside this unit's allowed files and the e2e evidence for AC-dm-01/02/03 belongs to integration. The Play dev-link opening with `data/` deleted was not run either (needs the Play desktop runtime).

Home screens carry no data-aioson-tour attributes and are outside this unit. OnboardingTour looks up `[data-aioson-tour=<anchor>]` first and falls back to the existing data-aioson-id of each region (owner: escada, home-trava, result-actions, home-draft, nav; consultant: escada, consult-stalled, consult-old, nav). AppShell's nav now has data-aioson-tour="nav". If a step's region is absent (e.g. no lock note), the card shows centered over the scrim and the step count stays 5/4.

evidence.summary: tsc --noEmit and vite build completed (built in 1.30s); only the existing >500 kB chunk-size warning.

App.tsx index route renders RootRedirect: GET /api/companies (active, then archived) -> no company => Navigate #/boas-vindas, else #/inicio. #/boas-vindas shows 'Vamos descobrir em que degrau a sua empresa está' with no DB/port/login/config screen; AppShell hides nav, mode chip and '?' on /boas-vindas*.

'Para a minha empresa' / 'Atendo várias empresas' navigate to #/boas-vindas/empresa?modo=owner|consultant. 'Começar o diagnóstico' validates name/segment/sales channel (+optional revenue, CNPJ), then createCompany -> savePreferences({usageMode, focusCompanyId}) -> startDiagnosis(companyId) -> navigate #/diagnostico/:id (new draft opens on block 1, 'Seus números'). A retry after a later step fails reuses the created company.

TourProvider (OnboardingTour.tsx) wraps AppShell; auto-opens once per mode on #/inicio when tourSeen[mode] is false and the first region exists (home with data). 5 owner steps / 4 consultant steps, 'N de M' counter, 'Pular o tour', Voltar, Próximo/Entendi, Esc closes; closing saves tourSeen[mode]=true. The header '?' (data-aioson-id tour-reopen) calls openTour, navigating to #/inicio first when needed.

messages.text: Run the deferred first-run checks: write tests/e2e/firstRun.spec.ts in the fresh-db Playwright project and run `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/firstRun.spec.ts`. Selectors available: wizard-mode, wizard-mode-empresa, wizard-mode-consultoria, wizard-company, wizard-form, wizard-submit, wizard-back, wizard-error, root-loading, root-error, tour-card, tour-count ('1 de 5' / '1 de 4'), tour-skip, tour-prev, tour-next, tour-reopen, tour-highlight. Then in the Play dev-link delete data/ and confirm the app opens on the wizard and ends on 'Seus números'.

src/features/home/OnboardingTour.tsx exports TourProvider (mounted in App.tsx inside HashRouter, around AppShell), useTour() -> { openTour() } and TOURS. Any screen may call useTour().openTour() (e.g. a 'Rever o tour' button in Configurações). App.tsx index route no longer redirects to /empresas; it decides between #/boas-vindas and #/inicio (BR-dm-11).

Optional polish outside this unit: add data-aioson-tour attributes on the home regions (escada/trava/acoes/rascunho in OwnerHome, carteira/parados/antigos in ConsultantHome) to match the prototype; the tour already finds them through their data-aioson-id fallbacks.
